title: MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS
subtitle: MONDAY. CHAIR SQUATS, STEP-UPS, REVERSE LUNGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, FIGURE-FOUR, WALL CHEST OPENER. LEGS AND LUNGS FIRST, THEN OPEN THE HIPS AND CHEST.

script.welcome: MONDAY, GRIMES. WEIGH IN DAY. WHATEVER THE SCALES SAID THIS MORNING, YOUR LEGS STILL REPORT TO ME. LEGS AND LUNGS, SIXTEEN MINUTES. ON YOUR FEET.
script.rest: REST. IN THROUGH THE NOSE, OUT THROUGH THE MOUTH.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT COUNT. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. NEW WEEK, GRIMES. PROTEIN AT LUNCH, KEEP THE EXTRAS TIGHT, AND BOTH WALKS TODAY. TWO TWENTY NINE IS WAITING FOR YOU, AND I WANT TO WATCH YOU GET THERE. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: CHAIR SQUATS
exercises.cue: STAND IN FRONT OF A STURDY CHAIR, FEET HIP-WIDTH. SIT BACK AND DOWN UNTIL YOU LIGHTLY TOUCH THE SEAT, CHEST UP, KNEES OVER TOES. STAND UP BY DRIVING THROUGH THE HEELS. NO FLOPPING ONTO THE CHAIR.
exercises.speakStart: CHAIR SQUATS. THREE ROUNDS OF TEN. SIT BACK, KISS THE SEAT, STAND UP THROUGH THE HEELS. TOUCH IT, DON'T MOVE IN. YOU SIT IN THAT CHAIR ALL DAY, GRIMES. NOW LEARN TO GET OUT OF IT.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS (BOTTOM STAIR)
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR, HAND ON THE RAIL IF NEEDED. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, DRIVE UP, STAND TALL, STEP DOWN UNDER CONTROL. ALTERNATE THE LEAD LEG. STEADY PACE FOR 30 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. BOTTOM STAIR. THREE ROUNDS OF THIRTY SECONDS. WHOLE FOOT ON, DRIVE UP, STAND TALL, STEP DOWN SOFT. SWAP LEGS. THIS IS THE LUNGS PART, GRIMES. PUFFING IS ALLOWED. STOPPING IS NOT.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. LUNGS OPEN. GOOD.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGES
exercises.cue: STAND TALL, FINGERTIPS ON A WALL OR CHAIR IF NEEDED. STEP ONE FOOT BACK AND LOWER UNTIL BOTH KNEES BEND, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE. PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO STAND. 6 EACH LEG, SLOW.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO ROUNDS, SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK, DROP SLOW, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE. PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL. FINGERTIPS ON THE CHAIR IF YOU NEED THEM. NO BOUNCING. THIS ISN'T A DISCO.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE
exercises.cue: STAND ON ONE LEG, KNEE SOFT, FINGERTIPS ON A WALL OR CHAIR IF NEEDED. HINGE FORWARD AT THE HIPS AS THE FREE LEG REACHES BACK, FLAT BACK, HIPS SQUARE. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU CONTROL. STAND TALL SLOWLY. 5 EACH LEG.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. BALANCE. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE EACH LEG. STAND ON ONE LEG, TIP FORWARD FROM THE HIPS, BACK LEG REACHES BEHIND. FLAT BACK. FINGERTIPS ON THE WALL IF YOU WOBBLE. TIRED LEGS WOBBLE MORE. THAT'S THE POINT.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR STRETCH
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. THREAD HANDS BEHIND THE BOTTOM THIGH AND DRAW IT GENTLY TOWARD YOU UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP. HEAD DOWN, SHOULDERS RELAXED. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ON YOUR BACK, ANKLE OVER THE KNEE, PULL THE THIGH IN GENTLY. FEEL IT IN THE OUTER HIP. THOSE LEGS JUST WORKED. NOW LET THEM GO.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: FOREARM ON THE WALL AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, ELBOW BENT 90 DEGREES. STEP THROUGH WITH THE NEAR FOOT AND TURN THE CHEST GENTLY AWAY UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, NO PAIN. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL, STEP THROUGH, TURN THE CHEST AWAY. GENTLE. A WEEK OF KEYBOARD IS COMING FOR THOSE SHOULDERS. GET AHEAD OF IT.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN, SHOULDERS BACK. MONDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
